evidence.environment: Fleet source repository, CLI 2.1.226, sonnet clean-room batches
evidence.source_reference: LEARN-002 calibration round at b2835ad: 22 of 76 sessions were diagnostic re-runs existing only to recover final text scripts/eval_behavioral.py had already read and dropped

expected_behavior: Failing behavioral runs under --output-dir retain the session's final text beside the benchmark artifact, so a GRAMMAR-vs-TEXT call is offline and free; passing runs and the routing runner (which grades a tool call, not prose) stay as they are.
observation: The behavioral runner discards the transcript it graded, so every grammar-vs-text calibration call on a failing case requires re-buying the session before the decision can be made offline; four contracts ended the round unsettled at 1-2/3 for exactly this reason -- repairing a grader without the observed sentence is how it gets tuned into agreeing with itself.
reason: Landed: failing runs under --output-dir write their final text to failing-run-evidence.json beside the benchmark, carrying run_index, assertion failures, and a conditions copy so the file states what it measured. Passing runs stay opt-in under --retain-run-evidence, which supersedes the separate file rather than duplicating its bytes; the conditions block names which form is present so an absent file reads as every-run-passed. Four firing tests, each proven non-vacuous by mutation.
